overloads.semanticRole: Runs an interactive or programmatic query against the records currently selected in the explicitly given aTable, replacing its current selection.

discriminatedBy.rule: Chosen when the target table is passed explicitly rather than relying on the default table.

overloads.semanticRole: Runs an interactive or programmatic query against the records currently selected in the default table, replacing its current selection.

discriminatedBy.rule: Chosen when aTable is omitted; applies to the default table.

constraints: Scope differs from QUERY: QUERY SELECTION only searches within aTable's current selection, whereas QUERY searches every record in the table; otherwise both commands share the same queryArgument syntax and multi-call '*' chaining behavior (see QUERY).
Most useful when a query needs to run against a current selection that did not itself come from a previous QUERY call (e.g. one produced by USE SET).
_needsReview: Same alphanumeric-comparator calling form caveat as QUERY: the field/comparator/value 3-argument form is documented by reference to QUERY's own docs but not modeled as a separate Overload here.
